# Fleet Step (`features:open-hand-fleet-step`)
**Class:** [Monk](../classes/monk.md) | **Subclass:** [Warrior of the Open Hand](../subclasses/warrior-of-the-open-hand.md) | **Level:** [Monk 11](../levels/monk-11.md)

When you take a Bonus Action other than Step of the Wind, you can also use Step of the Wind immediately after that Bonus Action.
